newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures firmer on technical buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures firmer on technical buying.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Tuesday, lifted by technical-driven buying in late afternoon session, traders said.
The newly listed benchmark February ended at 141.3 yen per kg after opening at 139.9 yen on Tuesday. Other contracts ranged from 1.4 yen to 1.6 yen per kg higher.

The market started the day on a firmer tone. Stable rubber prices in producing countries also provided support to the market, they said. "Although sentiment here improved slightly, increased rubber stocks at home has cast a shadow on the market," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
